title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
target_audience: Small and marginal farmers across India
benefits: ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to bank accounts in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families who have cultivable land in their names. Excludes institutional landholders, high-income taxpayers, and government employees.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account linked to Aadhaar (eKYC completed), Land Ownership records (Khasra/Khatauni), Mobile Number.
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Agriculture Office.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
target_audience: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas facing crop damage.
benefits: Comprehensive crop insurance covering yield loss due to non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, pests, storms). Premium is only 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops.
documents_needed: Land sowing certificate (Patwari/Revenue official), Land possession certificate/Rent agreement, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
how_to_apply: Enroll through pmfby.gov.in, your bank branch, cooperative society, or CSC within the cut-off date. Claim within 72 hours of crop damage via Crop Insurance App.

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
target_audience: Bottom 40% vulnerable and low-income families in rural and urban India.
benefits: Free cashless health insurance cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization in empaneled public and private hospitals.
eligibility: Identified by Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) or state welfare rolls. No restriction on family size or age.
documents_needed: Ayushman Card (Golden Card), Aadhaar Card, Ration Card.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at beneficiaries.nha.gov.in or visit any Ayushman Arogya Mandir / empaneled hospital with Aadhaar and Ration card to create Ayushman Card.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
target_audience: Farmers, animal husbandry rearers, and fishers.
benefits: Short-term credit for crop cultivation at subsidized interest rate of 4% (effective with prompt repayment subvention) up to ₹3 Lakh. Collateral-free loan up to ₹1.60 Lakh.
eligibility: Individual/joint cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and Self-Help Groups.
documents_needed: Duly filled application, Land records (7/12 extract or Jamabandi), Aadhaar, PAN or Voter ID, Passport photo.
how_to_apply: Apply at any rural, commercial bank branch or cooperative bank, or through PM-KISAN portal (KCC link).

title: PM KUSUM Solar Pump Scheme
target_audience: Individual farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, water user associations.
benefits: Up to 60% subsidy for installing standalone solar agriculture pumps (Component B) or solarizing existing grid-connected pumps (Component C). Extra electricity can be sold back to DISCOM.
eligibility: Farmers with agricultural land seeking day-time uninterrupted power and replacement of diesel pumps.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership document, Bank account passbook, Electricity bill (for grid pump solarization).
how_to_apply: Apply through State Renewable Energy Development Agencies (e.g., PEDA in Punjab, UPNEDA in UP) or state agriculture portals.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
target_audience: Houseless families and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses in rural areas.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 Lakh in hilly/difficult areas for constructing a permanent pucca house with toilet, plus 90 days MGNREGA wages.
eligibility: Identified through SECC 2011 and Awaas+ list verified by Gram Sabha.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details, Job Card (MGNREGA), Land document.
how_to_apply: Selected beneficiaries are verified by Gram Panchayat and Block Development Office (BDO).

title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
target_audience: Adult women belonging to BPL / economically weaker rural households.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection, free stove (hotplate), free first cylinder refill, and ongoing targeted subsidy of ₹300 per refill.
eligibility: Adult woman from eligible BPL / rural poor households without an existing LPG connection in the home.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card of applicant and adult family members, Ration Card, Bank Passbook linked to Aadhaar.
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas) or online at pmuy.gov.in.

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
target_audience: All farmers wanting to know soil fertility and optimize fertilizer costs.
benefits: Free testing of 12 critical soil parameters (N, P, K, S, Zinc, Iron, Cu, Mn, Boron, pH, EC, OC) and customized dosage recommendations for urea/DAP to cut fertilizer costs by 20-30%.
documents_needed: Land details, Soil sample collected from field with assistance of Krishi Sahayak.
how_to_apply: Contact local Agriculture Extension Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) to have soil sampled.

title: e-Shram Card for Unorganized Workers
target_audience: Agricultural laborers, street vendors, domestic workers, construction laborers aged 16-59.
benefits: Universal 12-digit UAN card, ₹2 Lakh accidental death cover (under PMSBY), direct access to state and central social security welfare schemes.
eligibility: Unorganized workers not paying income tax and not enrolled in EPFO/ESIC.
documents_needed: Aadhaar number linked with active mobile number, Bank Account details.
how_to_apply: Self-register on eshram.gov.in or visit any CSC centre.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
target_audience: Parents of girl child aged below 10 years.
benefits: Highest sovereign government interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a., compounded annually), tax-free maturity amount for girl's higher education and marriage.
eligibility: Girl child residing in India up to age 10. Maximum 2 accounts per family.
documents_needed: Birth Certificate of girl child, Identity & Address proof of parent/guardian (Aadhaar/PAN).
how_to_apply: Open account at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank with minimum ₹250 initial deposit.
